messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: How put accents en Shiny app
parts:
Eventually we tried to solve the problem of multi-byte characters
under Windows, and we will really appreciate it if you can help us
test it:

if (!require("devtools")) install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("yihui/shiny@bugfix/windows-encoding")

I have tested your example under Windows, and it seems to be working now.

Regards,
Yihui
